blurb: Guests can join the Lineage Wine Club to receive shipments of boutique wines three times a year with options to customize. The winery offers guided tastings of cider and wines in a farmhouse tasting room or garden setting. The vineyard practices traditional methods and focuses on quality and heritage in winemaking.
extraNote: Minimum of 3 shipments before cancelling wine club membership · Membership can be cancelled up to 30 days prior to next shipment cut-off date · Shipping charges apply and vary by province; discounted shipping for club members · Wine shipments scheduled in March, June, and November · Wine shipped only within Canada; no international shipping · Wine is perishable; 8th Generation not responsible for damage from extreme weather during shipment · Farmhouse Tasting Room at 6807 Hwy 97, Summerland, BC
